title: Interpolation results quality centers
description: The Wannier centres against the atoms of the manifest's material, over periodic images; present when a spread was evaluated and the manifest names atoms.

nearest_atom_distance_bohr.description: Per function, the distance to the nearest atom.

nearest_bond_midpoint_distance_bohr.description: Per function, the distance to the nearest midpoint of a bond.

shortest_bond_bohr.description: The shortest interatomic distance, which defines a bond here as anything within 20 percent of it.
